scope: Recorded native UR5e trajectory with independently reconstructed liquid display; no new physics.
fluid_material: OmniSurface_ClearWater, local pink transmission, thick surface
particle_view: Original particle positions shown as opaque debug spheres; same glass, light, camera and robot.
surface_method: Weighted-centre implicit surface with a nearest-particle support guard and per-component volume-constrained isovalue; marching cubes. No particle removal, position edits, vessel clipping or temporal interpolation.
preserved_failures: Unconstrained preview inflated displayed liquid volume up to 1.82 times the model volume.
Earlier previews captured RaytracedLighting after scene loading overrode requested PathTracing; retained and not presented as path tracing.
physical_resolution_gap: 3.75 mL spread across an 87 mm inner-diameter receiver forms a mean 0.63 mm layer, below 2.5 mm initial particle spacing. Thin-layer and stream continuity remain unvalidated.

sources.title: Zhu and Bridson surface reconstruction inspiration
